Accessibility

Movement is personal. Access to the page should be, too.

Landing page preview. Updated October 22, 2026. App-specific contacts and procedures are awaiting confirmation.

Features in this page

This landing page includes semantic sections, keyboard-accessible links and buttons, visible focus indicators, image descriptions, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support. Information dialogs can be closed with the Escape key.

Scope and verification

These notes describe implemented page features. They are not a claim of certification or full conformance with an accessibility standard. Browser, screen-reader, and assistive-technology testing has not yet been completed.

Accessibility feedback

A verified accessibility or support contact will be added when confirmed. This preview does not collect feedback submissions. The accessibility of the Footprint app must be assessed separately from this landing page.
